node.label: Heritage & archaeology
node.summary: Monuments, temples, excavations and traditional knowledge.

facts.text: Chola bronzes were cast by the **lost-wax (cire perdue)** method; the Ananda Tandava Nataraja is associated with **Chidambaram**.
facts.plain: Chola bronzes were cast by the lost-wax (cire perdue) method; the Ananda Tandava Nataraja is associated with Chidambaram.

facts.text: Tamil Nadu archaeologists unearthed **Chola-era** bronze idols of **Nataraja** (Ananda Tandava, four arms, 110 cm) and **Goddess Sivagami** (Tribhanga posture) in **Nagapattinam**, dated to the **12th century AD**.

facts.text: **IIT Jodhpur** documented the astronomy of tribes (Bhil, Meena, Banjara, Gond, Kolam, Korku) and built a **'Nakshatra Vatika'** at Nandiya Kalan village matching trees (jamun, peepal, khejri, banyan) to constellations; the study went to the Education Ministry's **Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) Division**.

facts.text: **Somnath** temple (Prabhas Patan, **Gir Somnath** district, Gujarat) is regarded as the first of the **12 Jyotirlingas**; it was rebuilt after Independence on Sardar Patel's initiative and inaugurated in **1951**.
